A four-year-old car at one third of the new price.

Kevin Trudeau shares how he bought two used cars instead of new ones. One was ten years old with very low mileage, the other four years old. He says he paid about a third of the new price for the second.

His point: a new car loses about two thirds of its value in four years, so buy used, at least three years old, and favor things that hold their value.

What was the last big purchase you made that lost value fast?
